class.name: MidiPart
class.brief_description: A clip playing on a [MidiDriver], as [method MidiDriver.place_clip] and [method MidiDriver.play_clip] return it.
class.description: It only refers to the part: dropping it does not stop the part. Muting and channel changes apply to what the part plans from then on; the driver plans a lookahead ahead (about 100 ms), so they are heard that much later at most, and notes already sounding play on to their ends.

method.name: get_follow_tempo
method.description: Whether the clip's tempo map sets the driver's tempo as the part plays.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: [code]true[/code] while the part is on its driver: a part on the song stays until [method remove]; a part from [method MidiDriver.play_clip] until it has played its repeats, or a stop or seek drops it.

method.name: is_track_muted
method.description: Whether one of the clip's tracks is muted.

method.name: remove
method.description: Takes the part away: nothing more is planned, and its notes sounding or about to sound end now.

method.name: set_channel
method.description: Plays the clip's channel [param from] on channel [param to] instead (both 1-16), so one clip can play on another instrument.

method.name: set_follow_tempo
method.description: Whether the clip's tempo map sets the driver's tempo as the part plays: on for [method MidiDriver.place_clip], off for [method MidiDriver.play_clip].

method.name: set_muted
method.description: Mutes or unmutes the whole part.

method.name: set_track_muted
method.description: Mutes or unmutes one of the clip's tracks (see [member MidiClip.track_names]).
